2026-11-25 起，本站不能再挂「穿过盘口」的单：卖单的单价必须高于别人现: Since 2026-11-25, orders that cross the order book can no longer be posted on this site: a sell order must be priced above the highest existing buy order from others, and a buy order below the lowest existing sell order from others. The reason: when your sell price is not higher than an existing bid (or your bid is not lower than an existing ask), the trade can simply fill, so there is nothing to post. Tap "Sell" or "Buy" on that order in the book and it fills right away (the taker pays a 1% fee). If you want to post an order and wait, change the price to the number given in the message. Orders already posted are not affected, and the platform does not set any spread between buy and sell prices.
